interns.coverLetter: Passionate about building tokenized design systems and high-speed Next.js applications.
Researching RAG evaluation pipelines and agentic tool-use benchmarks at NUST.
Focused on accessible design tokens, micro-interactions, and high-craft Figma component libraries.
Built 3 production React Native apps with offline sync.
Looking to join the Winter 2026 6-month industrial placement track in Web Development.
Experienced with Playwright E2E test suites and GitHub Actions CI workflows.

tasks.title: Architect Tokenized UI Component Library (Logix v1.0)
tasks.description: Build Button, Badge, Card, Input, and Modal components matching the Logix Design System v1.0 specifications with full dark mode support.
tasks.submissionNotes: Implemented all semantic color tokens in globals.css and verified WCAG contrast ratios.
tasks.mentorComments: Exceptional attention to typography scale and zero layout shift. Approved with full credit.

tasks.title: Build Responsive Portfolio & Case Studies Filtering Engine
tasks.description: Implement client-side category filtering, case study metric cards, and smooth Framer Motion transitions.
tasks.submissionNotes: Completed with keyboard accessible filter tabs and responsive grid.
tasks.mentorComments: Clean state management and fast rendering.

tasks.title: Implement Multipart Resume Upload & Nodemailer Notification API
tasks.description: Create Next.js App Router POST endpoint `/api/apply` with file validation (10MB limit) and HTML email dispatch.
tasks.submissionNotes: Added drag-and-drop upload zone and MIME type verification.
tasks.mentorComments: Production-ready implementation. Great job completing all 3 cohort milestones!

tasks.title: Benchmark Hybrid Semantic + BM25 Retrieval Pipeline
tasks.description: Evaluate top-k recall accuracy across 500 technical documentation queries and submit latency percentiles.
tasks.submissionNotes: Achieved 91.4% Recall@5 with reciprocal rank fusion.
tasks.mentorComments: Thorough evaluation notebook and clean latency charts.

tasks.title: Streaming Tool-Call Guardrails Middleware
tasks.description: Build schema validation and retry middleware for structured JSON tool calls in Python FastAPI.
tasks.submissionNotes: Implemented Pydantic v2 streaming validator with exponential backoff.

tasks.title: Multi-Agent Evaluation Dashboard UI Integration
tasks.description: Connect the FastAPI evaluation metrics endpoint to a live telemetry view.

tasks.title: Design Token Audit & Dark Mode Contrast Specification
tasks.description: Deliver complete Figma component matrix and token documentation for Logix Portal v1.0.
tasks.submissionNotes: All 28 component states documented with light/dark parity.
tasks.mentorComments: Flawless token hierarchy and developer handoff specs.

tasks.title: Offline SQLite Sync Layer for Field Service Mobile App
tasks.description: Implement optimistic queue synchronization when mobile device reconnects to network.
tasks.submissionNotes: Initial queue sync working on Android simulator.
tasks.mentorComments: Please add idempotency keys to prevent duplicate mutation replay when network flaps.

attendance.notes: Implementing idempotency keys per mentor review
